title: Share of kids who walk to school, among those living within a quarter mile

source.name: Children's Travel to School brief
source.publisher: Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), 2017 National Household Travel Survey

notes: FHWA's analysis of the 2017 NHTS found that 80.9% of children living a quarter mile or less from school usually walk there -- walking essentially only survives where school is already close by. Verified live via web search 2026-11-11.
